name: Aracena (Spain)
description: Crimson banner with a rounded fly, charged at the centre with a blue castle whose towers are surmounted by the castle of Castile and the lion of León, the elements of the old municipal seal.
history: The flag of Aracena is formed from the elements of its old municipal seal: a banner rounded at the fly in the proportion 11:18, a crimson cloth with a blue castle at the centre, its outer towers surmounted by the castle of Castile and the lion of León.

features.role: small castle of Castile above the towers
small lion of León above the towers
